about_the_game:
This demo was created specifically for the Steam Next Fest and includes only an action stage—
event scenes from the full game are not included.

Estimated playtime is about 20 minutes.
The featured stage is based on a mid-game level, but narrative details have been trimmed to focus on the core gameplay.
You'll experience high-speed combat and flashy effects using powerful weapons that normally appear later in the story.

There are very few restrictions on available weapons, allowing you to dive straight into the action and get a feel for the game's intensity and style.

※ The full version will include a complete storyline, cinematic event scenes, and additional content.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game may contain content that is not appropriate for all ages or may not be suitable for viewing at work: partial nudity, sexual themes, and other mature content in general.

The game features characters with revealing outfits and suggestive dialogue, but does not contain explicit sexual acts or direct depictions of sexual activity.
